From Corporate Knowledge to Interactive Content

Aidea, an AI venture that transforms organizations’ documents and knowledge resources into interactive, animated content within minutes, received pre-seed investment from ENA Venture Capital and RePie Portföy. While the financial size of the investment was not disclosed, it was stated that the venture will use this funding to develop the product and grow in the MENA and European markets.

Aidea enables users to manage the entire content production process from a central screen by bringing together different AI tools and models under a single roof. Outputs created through the platform can be turned into microlearning modules containing voice-over, avatar, animation, and question-answer flows.

More Than 40 Customized AI Agents

The platform uses AI agents focused on specific tasks to increase content production speed and quality. It enables the automation of processes and instant integration with LMS (Learning Management System), intranet, or similar corporate infrastructures.

Some of the prominent features of the Aidea platform are:

  • A custom AI layer integrated with corporate data.
  • Process automation with more than 40 customized AI agents.
  • Instant publishing capability through a central rich editing tool.
  • The capacity to transform scattered corporate knowledge into a scalable (Enterprise AI) structure.

The founding team, led by CEO Ali Kemal Karabulut, formerly of Microsoft, includes Ebru Zeybek (CSO) and İlter Sağ (CTO), specialized in technology and business development. The venture aims to become a global player in the Enterprise AI field, especially in the knowledge automation vertical.
